scope: S5 brokered adapter contracts. The sandbox adapter is exercised only through its declared control-client seam; this is not a protected Workspace sandbox, Firecracker, Linux/KVM, or EX-002 claim.

observations.broker_boundary: Builtin, MCP, and sandbox adapter entrypoints reject direct execution or reconciliation contracts before the fixture external-effect seam can run.
observations.bounded_recovery: Each adapter receives the Worker-owned operation identity only after brokered authorization; a lost acknowledgement is reconciled by that identity without a replacement submission.
observations.safe_surface: The adapter checks do not expose arbitrary event/history data or retain raw descriptors, credentials, or external-effect payloads.

redaction: No operation IDs, descriptors, capability values, credentials, endpoints, requests, responses, or external-effect payloads are retained.
